text: Provincial Armory: Garrisoned by a permanent defense force. Defeat the garrison to capture it. The occupying faction will gain bonuses to damage and armour within this province.
Provincial Granary: Garrisoned by a permanent defense force. Defeat the garrison to capture it. The occupying faction will gain a casualty replenishment rate bonus within this province.
